title: Cisco chairman and CEO Chuck Robbins says slowing AI unrealistic
key_facts: Chuck Robbins, Cisco chairman and chief executive, spoke to PTI on Wednesday 14 October.
He said efforts to slow AI will not succeed and focus should be on security and defences.
He said counter-defences have to move 'at the same pace or faster' than AI.
He said there should be logic around how models are released and around guardrails.
He said the more pressing risk is that AI models expose gaps in basic cyber hygiene at customers.
He does not see AI as a net job disruptor and expects it to move people up the value chain.
quote_evidence: "You are not going to slow it down. I mean, I just don't think that is going to happen," Robbins said.
"We certainly need to have logic around how models get released, logic around guardrails. We should know what's going on."
why_it_matters_hint: A major tech executive argues security, not a slowdown, is the answer to AI risk.
